NDT software in Lake Charles: refining, petrochemicals and LNG on the Calcasieu

Lake Charles has one of the more unusual inspection markets on the Gulf Coast. Within a short drive you have the CITGO Lake Charles refinery, the Phillips 66 Lake Charles refinery in Westlake, the Sasol Lake Charles Chemicals Complex, Westlake's chemical operations, and to the south in Cameron Parish the LNG export terminals: Cameron LNG at Hackberry, Calcasieu Pass LNG, and Sabine Pass LNG near the Texas line. More LNG capacity has been under construction in the area, which means fabrication, pipe spools, storage tanks and hydrotest packages all needing inspection.

The region also carries the memory of Hurricanes Laura and Delta in 2020, which damaged plants, tanks and buildings across Calcasieu and Cameron parishes and set off years of repair and rebuild inspection. Local NDT contractors learned to mobilise quickly after storms and to document a lot of work in a short time.

The typical Lake Charles NDT company is small to mid-sized, often with crews that also work Beaumont and Port Arthur across the Sabine River. They do RT and PAUT on new-construction pipe, PT and ferrite on stainless and cryogenic service, UT thickness on tanks and piping, and a lot of VT on structural and storm-repair work. The Atlantis ERP solution is set up to run that kind of business, and this page explains how each app applies to Lake Charles work.

ERP for NDT companies in Lake Charles

An ERP for NDT companies in Lake Charles should manage technicians who work both sides of the state line, instruments that travel long distances to remote LNG sites, and a flood of reports during construction and storm-repair peaks. The Atlantis ERP puts certifications, equipment, dispatch, reports, procedures, quotes and invoices in one configured system.

Lake Charles contractors typically outgrow spreadsheets when they pick up an LNG construction package. The volume of welds, the traceability expected by the EPC, and the pace of hydrotest schedules expose every gap between a crew roster in Excel and a separate reporting folder. With the Atlantis ERP, the same technician and instrument records drive Team Assignments, NDT Reports, Timesheets and Invoicing, so the report that goes to the EPC's QC manager and the invoice that goes to their accounts team come from the same data.

Technician certification tracking software for Lake Charles and Cameron Parish

Technician certification tracking in Lake Charles has an extra wrinkle: many crews are shared with Southeast Texas work, and EPCs on LNG projects often want to see qualifications under more than one scheme. The Atlantis ERP records each certification with scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level, method, certifying body and issue, expiry and renewal dates, and flags status automatically.

A technician's record holds OJT hours, training hours, exam results and scanned certificates, plus vision tests with near vision, colour perception and contrast results and their own expiry dates. The NDT profile shows highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry. When an EPC's QC lead asks for the qualification package for everyone on a night-shift RT crew at a Cameron Parish site, you pull it from one place instead of four folders.

Daily checks raise warning tasks 90 days before any cert or vision test expires, and email alerts go to the people you choose, with configurable look-ahead days and resend intervals. Company certifications, such as your ISO registration or client accreditations, are tracked with their own alert days. Timesheets warn if a technician logs work under a certificate that is not valid.

Crew dispatch software for remote LNG and plant sites

Crew dispatch software for NDT companies in Lake Charles has to deal with distance: sites in Hackberry or near the Sabine Pass are a long drive from a Lake Charles yard, and nobody wants to send a crew south only to find the wrong probe on the truck. The Atlantis ERP blocks double-booking of technicians and equipment serial numbers and warns when assigned equipment is out of calibration.

Each team assignment moves from planned to dispatched to in field to submitted to closed, and holds site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates. That helps on large LNG construction sites where the laydown yard, the tank area and the process trains have different access points. The availability calendar shows assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days, and overlapping bookings are blocked.

After a storm, when several clients call at once, operations managers can see technician status, current assignment, utilisation and next available date in calendar, kanban and list views, and decide quickly who can go where. The Fleet app records vehicle assignments to projects and drivers with dates and mileage, and whether each truck can carry radioactive sources, with transport licence number and expiry. That matters for RT crews moving between Louisiana and Texas work.

Calibration management software for Lake Charles instruments

Calibration management software for Lake Charles NDT companies should keep every instrument's calibration current even when equipment spends weeks on remote sites. The Atlantis ERP tracks each instrument by serial number with calibration frequency and status, calibration records and a certificate register with expiry alerts.

For each calibration, the record captures provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited lab flag, pass, fail or conditional result and next due date. The certificate register holds the lab's accreditation number and PDF with valid, expiring or expired status. The Purchase app flags vendors as OEM, dealer or calibration lab, with accreditation number and expiry, and purchase lines can be tied to a specific equipment serial, so the cost of recalibrating a particular PAUT unit is traceable.

Issue and return runs through supervisor and manager approval with condition recorded both ways. Reservations prevent clashes when two supervisors want the same TOFD setup for the same week. Consumables, from penetrant kits for stainless welds to couplant and PPE, carry reorder levels and low-stock flags. The maintenance log records probe replacements, firmware updates and repairs with condition before and after, which helps when salt air and heat have been hard on equipment.

NDT reporting software for LNG construction and plant inspection

NDT reporting software in Lake Charles must keep up with construction-rate weld volumes and still give each report full traceability. The Atlantis ERP includes 17 report types including RT, PAUT, TOFD, UT, PT, MT, VT, ferrite, PMI, UT thickness, holiday/coating and computed radiography, each with its own numbering sequence.

On LNG and cryogenic work, ferrite and PT reports on stainless welds sit alongside RT and PAUT reports for the same weld map. PAUT reports record focal laws; RT reports record source, technique, IQI type and placement; computed radiography has its own report type. Weld lines record defect type and orientation, and each report carries an overall result. Work order, WPS, drawing, contract, procedure and standard references are captured on the report, which is what an EPC's turnover package needs. Holiday and coating reports cover coating inspection on tanks and buried piping.

Reports move through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a field for a third-party inspector. Technicians in the field use the offline app, since signal is patchy on parts of the coast, with photo capture and on-screen signatures. For storm-damage or tank work where a client wants to see results on a 3D model, see Atlantis Digital Twins.

Procedures and document control for Lake Charles contractors

EPCs on LNG projects routinely ask for procedure submittals before work starts. The Atlantis ERP procedure register holds document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and the procedure text or file. Procedures move from draft through submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejection reasons recorded and approved revisions locked.

Every revision is stored as a snapshot, so when the EPC's comments come back and you issue revision 2, revision 1 is still there for the record. Approvers get email reminders when something is pending. The AI-assisted first draft helps a Level III get a new procedure, for example a ferrite measurement procedure for a new stainless package, to review stage faster, but the Level III still owns the final approval.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Lake Charles

NDT quoting and invoicing software in Lake Charles needs to handle long mobilisations, per diem, standby and cross-state crews. The Atlantis ERP quotations include job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, NDT service products by method and category, a branded PDF and online acceptance that converts to a sales order.

Timesheets separate inspection, travel, standby and setup time, with method, site, client, equipment serial, billable flag and rate multiplier, and approval before billing. Standby matters on LNG jobs, where crews often wait on fit-up or hydrotest. Field expenses and per diems for crews staying in Sulphur or Lake Charles hotels go through Expenses and can be re-billed to the job. Invoices show project, PO, site and industry sector, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals and lines by method, technician and equipment serial.

The financial dashboard gives revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and outstanding invoices across 12 months, which helps a Lake Charles owner see how construction packages compare with routine plant work.

Implementation for NDT companies in Lake Charles

We start by looking at the mix of your work: plant maintenance, LNG construction, storm repair, Texas crews. Then we configure the ERP to match, loading your written practice, cert schemes, report templates, instrument list, customers and sites. EPC-specific Excel report formats are set up as templates filled automatically from the ERP fields.

If an EPC or owner wants data in their own system, the open REST API integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. Anything that is not built in is configured during implementation. Atlantis NDT sets up and supports the system directly, and the founder is an ASNT NDT Level III, so conversations about RT crews, ferrite readings and weld maps do not need translating.

Many Lake Charles contractors go live before picking up a large construction package so the system is in place when volume arrives. Talk to us about implementation timing in Lake Charles.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for Lake Charles contractors?

The best fit is software that joins certifications, calibration, dispatch, reporting and billing for the mix of plant, LNG and storm-repair work common in the area. The Atlantis ERP is built for NDT companies and configured per contractor.

Can it handle crews that also work in Texas?

Yes. Technicians, jobs and sites are not tied to one state, and the Fleet app records source-capable vehicles with transport licence numbers and expiries. State-specific regulatory records are configured during implementation.

Does it support computed radiography and PAUT reports?

Yes. Computed radiography, PAUT with focal laws, TOFD, RT, UT and more are among the 17 report types.

Will it work at remote Cameron Parish sites?

The offline field app stores drafts and photos without signal and syncs later.

Can an EPC receive reports in their format?

Yes. Excel templates are filled automatically, and Word, PDF and HTML templates are supported.

Is pricing published?

No. Each implementation is scoped to your company and priced by quote on request.
